summary: The document contains code for a user control named StudentEmployment in the HSPnet application. The control includes a repeater for student employment data and an ObjectDataSource for data binding. It is designed to handle the presentation and interaction of student employment information within a web application.
purpose: The purpose of the StudentEmployment control is to manage and display employment-related information for students within the HSPnet application, particularly focusing on handling data binding and user interactions.
